title: Low pm_confidence — gate should fire on score
goal: Initial report should tend to gate.fired true with reason around confidence_score under 60. Exercise refine loop; after targeted feedback, gate may clear.

refinement_rounds.label: inject_constraints
refinement_rounds.feedback: Lock these in: we're a 50-person SaaS company, $85k budget, 4-month deadline starting May 2026, team is 1 PM + 2 devs + 0.5 UX. Build vs buy decision must stay open but default to build a lightweight React + Node + Postgres internal tool unless buy is clearly cheaper.

refinement_rounds.label: narrow_scope
refinement_rounds.feedback: Reduce scope to ONE pilot: track customer onboarding handoffs between Sales and CS only — success = 90% of handoffs visible in the tool within 1 week of close. Update assumptions and risks accordingly; I need confidence score at least 65.

expected.notes: If confidence stays under 60 after round 2, a third refine or approve-with-override is a product decision — capture gate reasons in results.
